import os import sqlite3 import uuid from datetime import datetime from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, g, render_template_string app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.environ.get('FLASK_SECRET_KEY', 'dev-secret-key') DATABASE = 'db.sqlite3' def get_db(): db = getattr(g, '_database', None) if db is None: db = g._database = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return db @app.teardown_appcontext def close_db(exception): db = getattr(g, '_database', None) if db is not None: db.close() def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) try: conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, last_modified_by TEXT, last_modified_at TEXT, summary TEXT ) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edits ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, modified_by TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT, edit_date TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(entry_id) REFERENCES entries(id) ) ''') conn.commit() finally: conn.close() @app.route('/entries', methods=['GET']) def list_entries(): db = get_db() rows = db.execute('SELECT id, title FROM entries ORDER BY title').fetchall() html = 'Wiki Entries' html += '

''', (entry_id, title, content, created_by, created_by, now)) db.commit() row = db.execute('SELECT * FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entry_id,)).fetchone() entry = { 'id': row['id'], 'title': row['title'], 'content': row['content'], 'lastModifiedBy': row['last_modified_by'], 'lastModifiedAt': row['last_modified_at'] } return jsonify(entry), 201 @app.route('/entries/', methods=['GET']) def get_entry(entryId): db = get_db() entry = db.execute('SELECT * FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entryId,)).fetchone() if not entry: return jsonify({'error': 'Entry not found'}), 404 edits = db.execute('SELECT * FROM edits WHERE entry_id = ?
